Description: matches_cron only supports * and */n syntax - no ranges, names, or special values like L or W

Title: scan_with_progress_sync clones live_files vector and does full sort on every 50-entry progress update
Description: scan_with_progress_sync clones live_files vector and does full sort on every 50-entry progress update
Resolution: Use incremental top-N maintenance (heap) and share via Arc instead of cloning the entire vector

Title: Async scan_with_progress acquires Mutex on every single file processed
Description: Async scan_with_progress acquires Mutex on every single file processed
Resolution: Use sharded counting (AtomicU64 per stat) and batch-update the result struct at intervals instead of per-file locking

Title: total_files is u64 in shared_scanner::ScanResult but usize in gui_common::ScanResult requiring constant conversion
Description: total_files is u64 in shared_scanner::ScanResult but usize in gui_common::ScanResult requiring constant conversion
Resolution: Standardize on u64 for file counts across all scan result types to match the domain

Title: FilePatternClassifier::classify_file uses Option::is_none_or which requires Rust 1
Description: FilePatternClassifier::classify_file uses Option::is_none_or which requires Rust 1.82+ while project declares edition 2021
Resolution: Replace is_none_or with matches(|threshold| size >= threshold) or explicitly bump MSRV in rust-toolchain.toml

Title: Two independent file categorization systems with different categories (12 vs 14) and divergent mappings
Description: Two independent file categorization systems with different categories (12 vs 14) and divergent mappings
Resolution: Unify into a single categorization registry loaded from config and shared across all scan backends

Title: shared-scanner directly imports gpu_compute creating compile-time coupling between CPU scanner and GPU backend
Description: shared-scanner directly imports gpu_compute creating compile-time coupling between CPU scanner and GPU backend
Resolution: Introduce a ScanProcessor trait with CpuProcessor and GpuProcessor impls; scanner depends on trait not concrete gpu_compute

Title: Mixed error types: anyhow::Result in shared-scanner, rusqlite::Result in DB, OllamaResult in ollama, String in main
Description: Mixed error types: anyhow::Result in shared-scanner, rusqlite::Result in DB, OllamaResult in ollama, String in main.rs CLI
